name: Awesome Banner Widget for Elementor
author: onlineinit

sections.description:
Awesome Banner Widget for Elementor is a simple, lightweight, and customizable background widget plugin designed specifically for Elementor Page Builder.

With this widget, you can easily add stunning customizable banners to your WordPress website, complete with background images, configurable buttons, titles, descriptions, and flexible alignment settings. Perfect for heroes, call-to-actions, and standard banners uniformly formatted for various screen resolutions.

Features

  • Customizable Background Images
  • Complete Typography Controls
  • Flexible alignment & max-width configurations
  • Responsive sizing & height parameters
  • Multi-button (repeater) functionality with dynamic styling controls
  • Fast and Lightweight – built without bulky dependencies.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/awesome-banner-widget-for-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Once active, open any page with Elementor.
  4. Search for the “Banner” widget and drag it directly onto your layout!
sections.faq:
Does it require Elementor?

Yes, you must have the core Elementor page builder installed and activated to use this widget.
